name: duopore-public-supply-split-allocation-cost
description: See the cost of splitting an order across suppliers using the quantities you choose.

interface.longDescription: See the cost of splitting an order across suppliers using the quantities you choose. Enter how much you plan to buy from each supplier, their quoted prices and order fees. See the total cost and any gap from your demand. Fees count only for suppliers you use. The app checks your chosen split; it does not find the best split or place orders.
defaultPrompt: Calculate the cost of splitting this order across these suppliers.
Does my chosen supplier split meet demand, and what does it cost?

positive.prompt: Use Supply Split Cost Scenario with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"requiredUnits":100,"allocations":[{"id":"Q1","allocatedUnits":60,"capacityUnits":60,"unitPrice":2,"orderFee":10},{"id":"Q2","allocatedUnits":40,"capacityUnits":100,"unitPrice":3,"orderFee":5}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"Allocated 100 of 100 units; scenario cost 255.","rows":[{"id":"Q1","allocatedUnits":60,"capacityUnits":60,"unitPrice":2,"orderFee":10,"appliedOrderFee":10,"allocatedCost":130,"allocatedTotalUnits":100,"demandDifference":0,"totalScenarioCost":255,"matchesDemand":true},{"id":"Q2","allocatedUnits":40,"capacityUnits":100,"unitPrice":3,"orderFee":5,"appliedOrderFee":5,"allocatedCost":125,"allocatedTotalUnits":100,"demandDifference":0,"totalScenarioCost":255,"matchesDemand":true}],"warnings":["Compare supplied figures in one currency for the same specification. No supplier verification, negotiation, ordering or payment occurs.","This evaluates your chosen allocation without finding a cheapest or most reliable allocation."]}
